resource_group.description: Existing or new resource group name

service_objective.description: Depends on edition, e.g. 'S0'-'S12' for Standard, 'GP_Gen5_2' for GeneralPurpose, 'BC_Gen5_2' for BusinessCritical, 'HS_Gen5_2' for Hyperscale, 'Basic' for Basic.

admin_login.description: SQL authentication admin username for the server. Defaults to 'sqladmin' if not specified. The password is never collected via chat — supplied separately at terraform apply time.

notes: service_objective valid values depend on edition — validate together
license_type affects cost significantly — always confirm explicitly
environment_tag is required for cost tracking / policy compliance
max_size_gb is capped by edition (e.g. Basic supports at most 2 GB) — if edition is Basic, confirm max_size_gb explicitly rather than relying on the general 32 GB default
